description:
We are SindiMinds, an Astrophysics and Earth science enthusiastic duo from Sindibad Olympiad High School, Morocco. During middle school, Ilyas and I were always fascinated by the mysteries that surrounded our tiny blue planet. We want to unveil those intriguing mysteries through the universe, mathematics, and physics.

We hope that our efforts will reflect our deep passion for Astrophysics and Earth Science, and that our work receives recognition and appreciation from the NASA community.
